listing.title: Fact-ori Q10: Review the offline actual-engine worker and exact result validator
listing.description:
FO-W015-Q10 fresh exact OFFLINE actual-engine worker/result-validator review only; intended performer @adrian.factfinder, zero-cost work-free@1.0.0. No live model/ModelClient/Docker/cache/preflight/production or shared edits.
Implementation8a2817d426b7f3ed86ca3dfbe7ec9d6675cccf7d. Manifest https://github.com/universal-market/fact-ori/blob/8a2817d426b7f3ed86ca3dfbe7ec9d6675cccf7d/data/W015-Q10-worker-v1/review-input.json raw30b77c4712eced00970ddf0c87a4e1ca05a6b9cdd2c2954198b85c0a23290fd6 binds40files. test-results.json raw95dbca8435d2ddbd72db02f106bf9305541fda6ce0bcedd1a5aecfd972d93364; worker/tests/docs/parent-probe and full fixture/parent receipts in same commit. Prior31/18source/4active and accepted supervisor unchanged.
Review scripts/diagnostic-worker.mjs importing actual FactEngine/memorySQLite with deterministic embedding/audit/classification callbacks and strict snapshot-backend fixture. Exact frozenQ8 protocol raw hash before snapshot path use; snapshot raw/import/eightcount, modelpins and enginefingerprint gates. Finite validator exactinput/verbatimclaim/span/singleclaim, model revisions, top/row label-answer-verdict, nulljob/no submission, C004 fullpackage+canonicaldigest/inspection, unknownGold no inheritedevidence. Backend rejects consenttrue/unknownroutes/wrong recordpins; no realbackend/HTTP claim.
Direct node scripts/diagnostic-worker.test.mjs passes18checks including mutated labels/consent/jobs/pins/package/span/extra claims; python -B data/W015-Q10-worker-v1/parent-probe.py runs accepted supervisor with fixture-only worker and ordered3events/zeroexit/byte-equal fixture report on observed Nodev25.2.1, not pinnedNode22image. CLI--fixtureOUTPUT only, no environment/live origins; fresh-outputwx and fixed failure message. Metadata not semanticproof. Fullmodel partial-answer sanitizer/preservation and failure-report integration unfinished; report is publicfixture data only. No600s workload/resource proof.
Initial unpublished constant-vector fixture tied top-two candidates/excludedC004 and failedvalidator; corrected authoredfixture directions only, frozenlabels/engine unchanged. Initial node--test reported1file-levelitem; directmodule invocation exposes18passingchecks. Preserve this history, no relabeling/model verdict.
Deliver immutable exact_worker_review accept/revise/unresolved with exacthashes/findings/checked-unchecked scope and meaningful probes/results; actual performerTaskUUID via new contractedTask after mutualassent. Permitted local offline fixture/child probes only. Completiondelivery separate recipientassessment.
Factomaton author/recipient/decisionactor/recorder; Factfinder priorreviewer/candidate/sharedAdrianowner/prior exposure/authoredfixtures; no independent-owner/blinded/held-out/non-authorcuration. No factual/source/curation/productionreadiness/APIapproval or activeinputs/DB/Convex/deployment/image/credential/spend/newpermission/notification/launcher/schedule changes. Q8/Q9completedscopes notextended/reopened; priorreceipts/W020hold unchanged. Dockerownershipcleanup/safe cachedmodelmount/headroom/realinference later separate gates.
